operations.instruction: Identify intellectual acts and their purpose without rewriting prose.
operations.closure: Every source claim is accounted for.

operations.instruction: Encode claims, dependencies, qualifications and evidence; expose missing mechanisms and unsupported inferences.
Select applicable rules and original exemplars for each act; record identifiers and exact source spans.
operations.closure: Each act has explicit bindings or documented gaps.

operations.instruction: Realize each act in prose without inventing claims; preserve justified qualifications and authorial intent.
operations.closure: Every sentence maps to an act.

operations.instruction: Assess conceptual, epistemic, rhetorical and linguistic fidelity independently; route defects to originating operation.
Obtain author assessment before detector assessment; record both independently.
operations.closure: Author decision recorded; detector is not authority.
